title: Rebuild the 29-CSV nflverse metric lab from scratch, reproducibly
why: The 15 metric families are documented in AGENTS.md but exist only on Garrett's machine. The repo cannot rebuild or verify them. This converts one-machine artifacts into versioned, reproducible data.
acceptance: every file carries a header row and at least one data row
a MANIFEST.json records the nflverse release, row counts and a sha256 per file
2026 Week 1 unadjusted team EPA ranks Jacksonville first, matching the published sanity check
notes: The four scripts are NOT in this repo yet; they live on Garrett's machine. Until they are committed here this job cannot run live, and --dry-run is the only honest mode. Getting those four scripts into version control is the real prerequisite and is worth more than the compute.
